text:
Aisha Khan: FYI everyone, final reminder 96 manager handbacks + reviewer forms are due end of day Friday PST. If youre OOO or on LOA, please set a proxy or request an exception.

Darren Lee: Quick Q 96 if a direct report was hired mid-cycle, do we use prorated goals or mark N/A on some sections?

Aisha Khan: Use prorated core commitments where applicable. For fields that dont apply, put N/A and add a one-line rationale in notes.

Maya Patel: Is there a way to split my calibration group? I have 14 people across two teams.

Aisha Khan: Yes, please split into two groups of ~7. When you upload the calibration template, add ":group: A / B" in the header so we schedule separate blocks.

Darren Lee: How do we bulk update handback dates? Im doing 9 people.

Aisha Khan: Use the CSV uploader (link in the form). Header must be exactly: `email,manager,handback_date,proxy,notes`. Example: 
```
email,manager,handback_date,proxy,notes
sam@redwood.com,darren@redwood.com,2025-06-20,maya@redwood.com,"prefers afternoon slot"
```

people-ops-bot: Reminder: 48 hours left to submit manager reviews for 12 items in Darren's queue. :bell:

Maya Patel: If a manager is the only reviewer (no alternate) and becomes unavailable last-minute, what happens?

Aisha Khan: We escalate to the manager's lead and assign a temporary reviewer. To avoid that, add your proxy in the form or email people-ops@redwood.com before 12pm Thu.

Darren Lee: Calibration notes format? Some of my writeups are long.

Aisha Khan: Keep calibration notes concise: 3 bullets max per person (expectation, 10s evidence line, recommendation). Use the short template: https://intranet.redwood.com/hr/calibration-short. Long writeups are fine as attachments but not required.

Maya Patel: One more 96 can we request morning or afternoon calibration slots?

Aisha Khan: Yes, in the template field `preferred_slot` add `AM` or `PM`. Well try to honor requests but no guarantees.

Darren Lee: Thanks 96 uploading CSV now.

Aisha Khan: Thanks all. If you hit any upload errors, paste the CSV snippet here and well help. Final calibration schedule posted by tomorrow EOD. :sparkles:
